summary: iter-216 — Round-20 security-audit verification on preview, STRICTLY READ-ONLY (no NL commands, no PANIC, no bot/account/trade mutation, deploy-watch NOT cancelled by this run). (b) GET /api/status 200, overall=degraded, trading.readiness.dominant_code='TERMINAL_STALE', 6 components present (api/database/bot_engine/ea_bridge/payments/email), decision=dec_0c7428040978 input v118, attestation not-attested, new-exposure refused. (f) GET /api/ops/deploy-preflight (admin) 200 with mongo_transactions signal present in body (keys: environment, verdict, fail_count, warn_count, checks, note). (g) GET /api/ops/deploy-watch 200 with status='cancelled' (see observation). Frontend smoke (admin login via TEST_ADMIN_* cookies): public /status renders data-testid=status-overall + status-trading-provenance and all 6 status-{api,database,bot_engine,ea_bridge,payments,email} rows; /accounts loads with 'EA' strip and 'v1.57' visible; /admin/preflight this run rendered all three required testids — preflight-check-mongo_transactions, signer-health-row, deploy-watch-card — the flake seen in iter-215 did NOT reproduce this run.
